---
title: "ECECWages_harmonize"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Inspect ECEC Wage Data
# ============================================================

# Load annual ECEC wage data
ecec_wages <- read_csv(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_ECEC",
    "ecec_wages_industry_annual_2004_2024.csv"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Basic structure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

glimpse(ecec_wages)

dim(ecec_wages)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Inspect the data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    industry_code
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Industry coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  distinct(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  arrange(industry_code)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Year coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year),
    n_years = n_distinct(year)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Observations per industry
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  count(
    industry_code,
    industry
  ) %>%
  arrange(industry_code)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check for duplicate industry-year observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry_code
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check for missing wage observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecec_wages %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_missing_wages =
      sum(is.na(wage_cost_per_hour))
  )
```
